page.layout: One printed page, single text column with no marginal notes and no footnotes. Running head "GRAMMATICA" at the top with page number "28" to its left. Below the head, a line continuing from the previous page, then section headings and paragraphs in reading order down to the last line.

main_text.p: musti. Ich wil deiner eingedenck sein/ ero tui memor.
Comparativo subjicitur dann vel als: ut, gold ist besser dann/ vel als/ silber/ aurum est melius argento.
Superlativo subjicitur vnter/ vel vber / vel in: ut, der beste vnter allen/ optimus omnium. der fürtreff-lichste vber alle/ praestantissimus omnium. Der reich-ste in der Statt/ ditissimus in urbe.
Nominativus praecedit verbum finitum, simili nu-mero & persona: ut, ich liebe/ amo, du schreibest/ tu scribis, er saget, ipse dicit.

Infinitum, aut tota oratio infinita, est Nominativi loco: ut, borgen macht sorgen / mutuam pecuniam sumere vel dare parit curas: Alteri enim incumbit necessitas solvendi & reddendi, alter timet, ne suum perdat.
Duo singularia postulat verbum plurale: ut, mein Vatter vnd Bruder sind kommen / pater meus & frater venerunt.
Verbum Activum regit Accusativum: ut, Nun lo-be mein seel den Herren / lauda mea anima Dominum.
Verbum Passivum regit Ablativum cum Adverbio von: ut, Himmel vnnd Erde sind von Gott ge-schaffen/ coelum & terra sunt à Deo creata.

Verbum fruendi, abstinendi, egendi, privandi, admirandi, insimulandi, regit genitivum: ut, Ich ge-niesse des/ fruor hac re. Enthalt dich des/ abstine ab hoc. Der Herr bedarff ihr[?]/ Dominus his opus habet. Einen seines guts berauben/ aliquem suis bonis spoliare.

page.notes: Black letter (Fraktur) is used for the German words throughout; these are marked with bl. Doubtful readings: "ihr" in "bedarff ihr" is marked [?]; the German words "dann", "als", "vnter", "vber", "in" and "von" are read as Fraktur but may be partly roman. The question headings are small italic lines set apart, so they are given level 3. The first line is the end of a paragraph continued from the previous page; the word "musti." is a fragment and is kept as printed.
